summary: Damadamm! is a 2011 Bollywood romantic comedy directed by Swapna Waghmare Joshi. Himesh Reshammiya stars opposite Sonal Sehgal and Purbi Joshi as a script writer who parties and flirts with other girls while his suspicious girlfriend is away, and chaos erupts when she returns. The film was released on 27 October 2011 and received negative reviews from critics.
one_line: Damadamm! is a 2011 Bollywood romantic comedy directed by Swapna Waghmare Joshi and starring Himesh Reshammiya.
